items.title: Suno lanza un nuevo modelo de IA para música tras múltiples demandas por derechos de autor
items.summary: Suno ha presentado un nuevo modelo de inteligencia artificial para la creación musical, actualmente en medio de varias demandas relacionadas con derechos de autor que la empresa enfrenta en la industria.

items.title: ElevenLabs unveils ‘Music v2.5’ – but UMG wasn’t involved
items.summary: Fresh from announcing a licensing deal with Universal Music Group, ElevenLabs has unveiled the latest version of its ElevenMusic AI-music service… while stressing that UMG is not involved in the latter. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: ElevenLabs’ $11B valuation is more than twice the size of Suno’s. It just struck a global AI music deal with UMG.
items.summary: ElevenLabs will launch an AI-powered music platform for fans under the deal, with the two companies also jointly developing AI audio products for artists and songwriters Source

items.title: Suno unveils upgrade developed with “music industry partners”, while continuing to battle the music industry in court
items.summary: Suno has unveiled v6 of its music AI platform, which has been developed with its industry partners like Warner Music, BMG and Believe. However, even as it starts to work with some labels and publishers on new AI products, it continues to fight other music companies in the courts

items.title: Crear música con IA basada en artistas reales no será un problema por este acuerdo de Suno con Warner Music y BMG
UMG’s ElevenLabs deal is latest move to AI remix experiences
items.summary: Another day, another AI-music deal for Universal Music Group. This time it’s ElevenLabs signing on the dotted line – its first agreement with a major following Kobalt and Merlin. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Stray Kids Label Hits Music Distributor With DMCA Subpoena Over Bootleg Track
items.summary: Stray Kids is one of the biggest bands in today's music industry. Because of that massive reach, a solo track from member Han went from a YouTube exclusive to bootleg releases on Apple Music and TikTok in days. Label JYP Entertainment now wants to identify the bootlegger. Instead of subpoenaing the platforms, it target…

items.title: “Tengo una visión del futuro”: el director de Suno defiende su modelo de IA musical en medio de la desconfianza de la industria
IFPI urges EU countries to fully implement AI Act’s new rules
items.summary: Yesterday was clearly the day for giving governments a kick up the backside when it comes to AI regulation. While AIM boss Gee Davy was addressing the UK government in London, global labels body the IFPI was holding an event in Brussels to launch the 2026 edition of its ‘Music in the EU’ report. The post is from Music…

items.title: Operator of AI music generator can’t escape copyright suit

tip.title: Content ID no es lo mismo que ser dueño
tip.body: Que YouTube reclame un video a tu favor no prueba titularidad, y que no lo reclame no significa que puedas usar la obra. Content ID es un sistema privado de la plataforma, no una autoridad legal.

items.title: Suno launches new AI music model amid multiple copyright lawsuits
items.summary: Suno has launched a new artificial‑intelligence model for music creation, while it is currently confronting multiple copyright lawsuits and its ongoing legal battles that challenge its operations within the music industry.

tip.title: Content ID is not proof of ownership
tip.body: A YouTube claim in your favor doesn't prove you own the work, and the absence of a claim doesn't mean you're cleared. Content ID is a private platform system, not a legal authority.
